name: Pipeline Status Digest

parameters.content: This workflow runs every day at 6:00 PM ET, retrieves all leads from the CRM, and sends the owner a Daily Pipeline Digest: counts by status, today's new leads + bookings, and any Stale leads needing a personal touch. Email is sent by default; SMS is built but off by default - both toggled via the CONFIG block at the top of 'Build Pipeline Digest'.

description: Daily 6PM ET pipeline digest. Emails owner lead counts by status, today's new/booked, and Stale leads needing attention. Email default ON, SMS built but OFF - both configurable via CONFIG block.
